stop_assignment_method: Unique polygon intersection using Shapely STRtree in EPSG:4326; ambiguous/no match is null. No nearest-stop imputation.
line_matching: Exact CRTM route_id; Renfe Madrid prefix10 and canonical C1 -> C-1, case/whitespace only. C-8A/B are not silently equated with C-8.
interpretation: A match means at least one published scheduled call in the municipality during the reference week. Catalogue agreement does not demonstrate complete mode/operator coverage, regular frequency, capacity, realtime service or absence of disruptions.
